# NOTION-Knowledge Capture Rules

Apply the following notion-knowledge capture rules guidance to the code or configuration you are changing. Check the stated preconditions and preserve behavior outside the authorized scope.

## Required checks

- Follow the workflow in `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/notion/skills/notion-knowledge-capture/SKILL.md`.
- Prefer deterministic scripts in `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/notion/skills/notion-knowledge-capture/scripts/`.
- Use references in `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/notion/skills/notion-knowledge-capture/references/` for factual guidance.
